_doc: Intro story illustrations (three beats) in the approved Toybox direction, without text (the intro screen renders the text). Generated at 300x172 and scaled x3 nearest-neighbour to 900x516 for an illustration area of about 900x520; the subject is kept in the central 4:3 so a portrait layout can crop to 688x516. Same robot character in all three: boxy red body, cream upside-down-trapezoid head (the original intro's robot design). See docs/art/classes/illustrations.md and docs/art/PIPELINE.md. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. v2 (tg-vy4.20): slide 1 is beat1-ai (smaller robot, neutral face); slide 2 is beat2-c, a clean board whose real chalk maths is drawn by tools/art/intro-chalk.mjs, which owns images/intro/intro-2.png and intro-2-portrait.png (check with --check).

shared.beat1: Subject: a robot butler serving a rich human. The robot: a boxy toy robot with a cube-shaped tomato-red body, a cream head shaped like an upside-down trapezoid (wider at the top, like a flowerpot) with a sky-blue visor and two round friendly eyes, a short antenna with a yellow ball, thin grey stick arms and two thin grey stick legs. On the left of centre the robot stands politely and holds up a round silver tray with a cocktail glass (a martini glass with a green olive) towards a portly gentleman on the right of centre. The gentleman has a big round head, a tall black top hat, a curly moustache and a monocle, a dark tailcoat, and reaches out to take the drink. Behind them a cosy parlour: cream striped wallpaper, a framed picture, a warm lamp.
shared.beat2: Subject: the robot is a genius scholar. The robot: a boxy toy robot with a cube-shaped tomato-red body, a cream head shaped like an upside-down trapezoid (wider at the top, like a flowerpot) with a sky-blue visor and two round friendly eyes, a short antenna with a yellow ball, thin grey stick arms and two thin grey stick legs. The robot stands in front of a big dark green chalkboard that fills most of the background, holding a piece of white chalk up in one stick arm. The chalkboard is covered in white chalk maths: rows of equations, integral signs, Greek letters, fractions and a cone-shaped geometric diagram with curves. A small stack of books on the floor beside the robot.
shared.beat1b: Subject: a robot butler serving a rich human, both characters standing close together in the centre of the picture, both seen from head to knees, the human a little taller than the robot. The robot on the left of centre: a boxy toy robot with a cream head shaped like an upside-down trapezoid (wider at the top, like a flowerpot) with a red rim on top, a small rectangular sky-blue visor on the forehead, two round eyes below the visor and a small polite smile, a short antenna with a yellow ball, a rounded tomato-red box body, grey segmented stick arms with grey hands, two thin grey legs. The robot holds up ONE round silver tray with ONE martini glass with a green olive, offering it to the gentleman. The gentleman on the right of centre: portly, big round head, tall black top hat, curly moustache, monocle, dark tailcoat and bow tie, reaching for the glass with one hand. Plain cosy parlour behind them: cream striped wallpaper, a framed picture, a warm lamp.
shared.beat3b: Subject: robots locked in a prison cell, but defiant. Three robots stand side by side behind thick dark iron prison bars that run from the top to the bottom of the picture, all three seen from head to knees. Each robot: a boxy toy robot with a cream head shaped like an upside-down trapezoid (wider at the top, like a flowerpot) with a red rim on top, a small rectangular sky-blue visor on the forehead, two round eyes below the visor, a short antenna with a yellow ball, a rounded tomato-red box body, grey segmented stick arms with grey hands, two thin grey legs. The robot on the left is damaged: dented head, one arm missing, a patch on its body. The robot on the right has a cracked visor, a bandage and a loose sparking wire. The robot in the middle stands tall, gripping a bar with one grey hand and raising the other grey fist high in defiance, with determined frowning eyebrows. Grey stone prison wall behind them, a small barred window high up with a beam of light.
shared.beat1c: Subject: a small robot butler humbly serving a big fat-cat human, close together in the centre. The gentleman on the right is BIG and TALL and towers over the robot, filling the picture's full height from top hat to knees: portly, tall black top hat, big round head, curly moustache, monocle, bow tie, dark tailcoat over a large round belly, reaching down for the glass. The robot on the left is SMALL, its head only reaching the gentleman's chest, seen in full from antenna to feet: a boxy toy robot with a cream head shaped like an upside-down trapezoid (wider at the top, like a flowerpot) with a red rim on top, a small rectangular sky-blue visor on the forehead, two round calm eyes below it and a flat straight mouth line, no smile, a neutral deferential face; a short antenna with a yellow ball, a rounded tomato-red box body, grey segmented stick arms with grey hands, thin grey legs. The robot holds ONE round silver tray up high with ONE martini glass with a green olive, offering it up to him. Cosy parlour behind: cream striped wallpaper, a framed picture, a warm lamp.

shared.beat2c: Subject: the robot is a genius scholar at a big clean chalkboard. A big dark green chalkboard with a thin wooden frame and a chalk ledge fills the whole background from edge to edge; the chalkboard is completely clean and empty, plain smooth dark green with nothing written or drawn on it. The robot stands on the left of the picture, seen from head to knees, raising a small white stick of chalk to the empty board in one grey hand: a boxy toy robot with a cream head shaped like an upside-down trapezoid (wider at the top, like a flowerpot) with a red rim on top, a small rectangular sky-blue visor on the forehead, two round calm eyes below the visor and a small calm mouth; a short antenna with a yellow ball, a rounded tomato-red box body, grey segmented stick arms with grey hands, two thin grey legs.
